Prevention: Ensure proper nutrition of cacao trees through fertilization (contact
COCOBOD for approved list and rates fertlizers)
Ensure proper farm husbandary practices, weeding, pruning, etc.
Monitoring: Look out for protrusions (lumps) on pods of all ages.
Protrusions are of different sizes, ages and shapes on pods.
Protrusions increase in size with the age of pod, turn yellow and then to dark brown lesions on ripened pods.
Phythophthora infection on pods, the lesions are soft and are also without spores
Direct Control: Remove infected pods as soon as observed
Remove or harvest infected pods as soon as observed
Restrictions: This disease is of low economic importance and no chemical control measures are advised for its management
